events.title: The Floor Under Micron’s Worst Case Is Written Into Its Contracts, Not Memory Prices
events.summary: Micron Technology's stock has seen significant returns, but the real story lies in its supply contracts. These take-or-pay agreements, signed during a memory shortage, provide a substantial floor for future revenue, with customers committing to buy specific volumes over the long term. While these contracts cap potential upside in soaring memory prices, they critically prevent significant downsides during market troughs, shifting the focus from volatile memory prices to contractual stability.

events.title: Analogue Computing Market Outlook Report 2026-2030 Featuring Profiles of Analog Devices, Texas Instruments, and Intel
events.summary: The global analogue computing market is projected to grow from $0.58 billion in 2025 to $1 billion by 2030, driven by demand for energy-efficient, high-performance alternatives to digital processing, particularly for AI acceleration, edge computing, and autonomous systems. Key trends include neuromorphic systems, hybrid analog-digital architectures, and real-time signal processing. North America leads the market, while Asia-Pacific is expected to be the fastest-growing region.

events.title: Analogue Computing Market Outlook Report 2026-2030 Featuring Profiles of Analog Devices, Texas Instruments, and Intel

events.title: Broadcom’s VMware Private AI Cloud spans infrastructure, agents, data and security
events.summary: Broadcom has launched VMware Private AI Cloud, an integrated software stack designed for enterprises to build and run AI applications alongside traditional workloads, ensuring data, model, and infrastructure control. The offering, announced at VMware Explore 2026, combines VMware Cloud Foundation infrastructure with a new VMware AI Factory, validated AI models, agent-development and data services, governance software, and enhanced security. Broadcom also introduced TrueSource, a portfolio of commercially supported open-source software, emphasizing secure software supply chains and enterprise-grade AI deployment.

events.title: KLA, Camtek, and Nova: Three Ways to Invest in Rising Process-Control Intensity
events.source: Dr. Robert Castellano's Semiconductor Deep Dive Newsletter
events.summary: The article discusses how AI is increasing the demand for inspection and metrology in semiconductor manufacturing, creating investment opportunities in process control companies. It highlights three companies—KLA Corporation, Camtek Ltd., and Nova Ltd.—each offering a different approach to investing in this trend. KLA is presented as the dominant broad-based platform, Camtek as focused on advanced packaging inspection, and Nova as a specialist gaining market share through dimensional, material, and chemical metrology.

events.title: Micron Technology (MU) Gains Driven by Earnings Upgrades
events.summary: Micron Technology (MU) has seen significant gains, driven by positive earnings revisions, despite previous market assumptions of overearning due to memory boom-bust cycles. The firm sold its position when MU shifted from the Russell 1000 Value Index to the Growth Index, adhering to its benchmark investment strategy.

events.title: Amkor's Global Footprint Expands: Can It Strengthen Customer Ties?

This strategic expansion, including facilities in Arizona and Vietnam, aims to deepen customer engagement through earlier design process involvement and multi-year partnerships with companies like TSMC and NVIDIA. Despite intensifying competition from rivals such as ASE Technology and Intel, Amkor's initiatives are expected to drive stronger customer retention and multi-year revenue growth.

events.title: Immutep Revenue Jumps on Dr Reddy’s Deal but Loss Widens on R&D Spend

events.title: Intel drops ‘fellow’ designation for its top scientists

This change, affecting 50 to 100 scientists, reflects Intel's heightened expectations for senior researchers to contribute more directly to business results and aligns with nomenclature across the tech industry. The move emphasizes a new standard of technical leadership focused on combining expertise with problem-solving, innovation, and measurable tactical progress as Intel experiences a resurgence driven by AI demand.

events.title: Apollo to repackage $9 billion ONEOK stake into debt deal

Apollo aims to structure the deal to achieve investment-grade ratings, leveraging its Capital Solutions business and Athene's balance sheet, and has executed over $100 billion in similar transactions previously.

events.title: VMware wants to become the enterprise home for AI agents

events.title: A look inside Apple’s relationships with Intel and TSMC

It discusses Intel's struggles to regain Apple's business due to issues like a perceived lack of commitment to manufacturing capacity and prematurely discussing potential deals. In contrast, TSMC's strong emphasis on trust, continuous investment in advanced technology, and discretion have solidified its position as Apple's preferred supplier.

events.title: Apple to Mac developers: It’s time to let go of Intel
events.summary: Apple has informed developers that they can now discontinue support for Intel-based Macs for universal macOS apps requiring macOS 13 or later. This move follows Apple's introduction of M-series chips nearly six years ago and its announcement that macOS 26 Tahoe would be the last version to support Intel Macs. Developers will need to assess their user base to determine when to fully transition away from Intel code, especially since macOS 27 will no longer run Intel-only apps on Apple silicon.

This award is tied to Dr. Dinu's continued service, with vesting scheduled through February 15, 2030, and the first tranche vesting on November 15, 2026. The grant was approved by the Compensation Committee and requires ongoing service for vesting at each scheduled date.

events.title: Intel shuts down Israel AI lab
events.summary: Intel is closing its agentic and inference optimization research laboratories in Israel, resulting in 13 layoffs. The company cited organizational considerations based on geographical location for the decision, which is part of a broader streamlining and restructuring program under CEO Lip-Bu Tan. This move is unusual for the industry, as other tech giants are aggressively investing in AI research.

events.title: Intel pivots: Folsom campus not for sale
events.summary: Intel has reversed its decision to sell its Folsom campus, indicating a strategic pivot for the company. This news comes after previous considerations to divest the property. The Folsom campus will remain under Intel's ownership.
